title: How Beavers Reshape Entire River Ecosystems
hook: Beavers live in freshwater ecosystems such as rivers.

scenes.narration: Beavers live in freshwater ecosystems such as rivers, streams, lakes and ponds.
In Europe, beavers were reduced to fragmented populations, with combined population numbers being estimated at 1200 individuals.
Combined population numbers were estimated for the Rhone of France, the Elbe in Germany, and southern Norway.
Numbers were also estimated for the Neman river and Dnieper Basin in Belarus and the Voronezh river in Russia.
The concept became popular in conservation and was deployed in a range of contexts to engender support for conservation.
The concept was mobilized where human activities had damaged ecosystems such as by removing keystone predators.
In addition, wolves often kept animals from grazing in riparian areas which protected beavers from having their food sources encroached upon.
Stream restoration or river restoration is a set of activities that aim to improve the environmental health of a stream.
